data.title: Custom domains without transfers
data.excerpt: Point your domain at your site with a handful of DNS records. It never changes registrars, never changes nameservers, and never leaves your control.

children.text: Every site on PremiumCMS starts on an assigned subdomain. When you are ready to serve it on your own domain, you set the Site URL in Settings → General and the platform issues the exact DNS records to add at your registrar — a CNAME for the site and a short set of records for email. Nothing else moves.

We never ask you to transfer a domain or delegate nameservers. Your DNS host stays your DNS host. The records route traffic to your isolated instance and prove ownership for the TLS certificate; the platform polls until they resolve and activates automatically.

If your DNS host is Cloudflare or Simply.com, Settings → DNS can apply the records for you: paste an API key, it is used once server-side for that batch of records, and it is never stored — you enter it again next time.
